findings.text: Still true. The 512-byte cap is not communicated in the UI. Client-side filtering never sends q (app.js:362-368), so the cap is unreachable today, but the API rejects a decoded q > 512 bytes with 400 before scanning (feature-brief.md:59-63; spec/core.md:29-37) and proto.html:37-39 has no maxlength or hint. Keep client-side filtering and document the cap as API-only, or add a byte-aware limit/hint and map 400 to a field error if s20 sends q. Do not use maxlength=512: it counts UTF-16 code units, not UTF-8 bytes.
findings.criterion: 512-byte cap communication
